pals.name: Lamball
pals.flavorText: A walk up a hill tends to end with this Pal tumbling back down. This causes it to become dizzy and unable to move, making it easy to capture and kill. As a result, this pal has tumbled down to the very bottom of the food chain itself.

ability.name: Fluffy Shield
ability.description:
When activated, equips to the player and becomes a shield.
Sometimes drops Wool when assigned to Ranch.

pals.name: Cattiva
pals.flavorText:
At a glance it appears full of confidence, but it is in fact weak and cowardly.
Being toyed with by a Cattiva is in many ways the greatest of disgraces.

ability.name: Cat Helper
ability.description: While in team, Cattiva helps carry supplies, increasing the player's max carrying capacity.

pals.name: Chikipi
pals.flavorText: Extremely weak and far too delicious. It is one of the weakest Pal alongside Lamball. No matter how many are hunted, they just keep appearing.

ability.name: Egg Layer
ability.description: Sometimes lays an Egg when assigned to Ranch.

pals.name: Lifmunk
pals.flavorText: Intelligent as a five to sever-year-old human child. It makes a wonderful partner, but there have been more than a few cases where they've killed their master after learning to use weapons.

ability.name: Lifmunk Recoil
ability.description: When activated, leaps into the player's head and uses a submachine gun to follows up player attacks.

pals.name: Fuack
pals.flavorText: Using its own body water, this Pal can create waves anywhere. It body surfs when in a hurry, but the resulting speed often ends in a fatal collision.

ability.name: Surfing Slam
ability.description: When activated, Fuack body surfs towards an enemy and slams into them.

pals.name: Vixy
pals.flavorText: The idol of Palpagos Island. If you bully a Vixy, you best be prepared to become enemies with the whole world.

ability.name: Dig Here!
ability.description: Sometimes digs up items from the ground when assigned to Ranch.

pals.name: Celaray
pals.flavorText: Riding the wind, this Pal travels where it pleases. Should it find a partner along the way, the encounter will mark its journey's end.

ability.name: Zephyr Glider
ability.description:
While in team, can be summoned and used instead of a glider.
Allows you to move quickly for long periods of time while gliding with this Pal.

pals.name: Cremis
pals.flavorText: Compared to Lamball, it has finer wool and a temperament more suited for domestication. However, it has historically been kept as a pet. Cuteness is considered a virtue.

ability.name: Fluffy Wool
ability.description: While in team, increases attack power of Neutral Pals. Sometimes drops Wool when assigned to Ranch.

pals.name: Teafant
pals.flavorText: Large amounts of water pour from what is thought to be its nose, though some say that it is, in fact, just snot. This has sparked a fierce debate among Pal scholars.

ability.name: Soothing Shower
ability.description: When activated, spouts mysterious water that soothes wounds and restores the player's HP.

pals.name: Gumoss
pals.flavorText: A strange Pal with a body resembling tree sap. It gradually loses strength if it has nothing to cover its body with, eventually rotting away.

ability.name: Logging Assistance
ability.description: While in team, improves efficiency of cutting trees.

pals.name: Jolthog
pals.flavorText: Releases the electricity stored in it's body when under attack, producing a shock that can be over 10 million volts. If thrown, it can even be more lethal than any conventional heavy weaponry.

ability.name: Jolt Bomb
ability.description: When activated, equips Jolthog to the player's hand. When thrown at an enemy, causes an electrical explosion upon impact.

pals.name: Jolthog Cryst
pals.flavorText: It releases cold air stored in its body when under attack. The frigid blast it radiates is cold enough to freeze the surrounding air and easily pierces through any attacker's body.

ability.name: Cold Bomb
ability.description: When activated, equips Jolthog Cryst to the player's hand. When thrown at an enemy, causes an icy explosion upon impact.

pals.name: Depresso
pals.flavorText: It has few friends because of the perpetually grouchy look on its face, but it is in fact kindhearted. Some have seen it feeding Vixy who have strayed from their pack.

ability.name: Caffeine Inoculation
ability.description: When activated, Depresso drinks a massive amount of energy drinks, causing its movement speed to increase.

pals.name: Pengullet
pals.flavorText: The feathers of this Pal have all but disappeared, but sadly, its desire to fly has remained as strong as ever. Even now, it tries to fly again in any way it can.

ability.name: Pengullet Cannon
ability.description: When activated, the player equips a Rocket Launcher and fires Pengullet as ammunition. Pengullet explodes on contact and is incapacitated.

pals.name: Penking
pals.flavorText: Surprisingly, it is unrelated to Pengullet. Ever wanting to be the center of attention, this Pal will strut its stuff for any onlookers.

ability.name: Brave Sailor
ability.description: When fighting together, Fire Pals drop more items when defeated.

pals.name: Hoocrates
pals.flavorText: Often lost in thought, it sometimes finds it difficult to sleep. "I think, therefore I am."

ability.name: Dark Knowledge
ability.description: While in team, increases attack power of Dark Pals.

pals.name: Melpaca
pals.flavorText: Don't be fooled by its fluffy appearance. A hypersonic kick from one of its long legs may send you flying to the other side of the world.

ability.name: Pacapaca Wool
ability.description:
Can be ridden.
Sometimes drops Wool when assigned to Ranch.

pals.name: Kingpaca
pals.flavorText:
Melpaca serve this Pal.
Contests between Kingpaca offer up their vassals as a wager. Those seen alone are losers of such contests.

ability.name: King Of Muscles
ability.description: Can be ridden. While in team, Kingpaca helps carry supplies, increasing the player's max carrying capacity.

pals.name: Kingpaca Cryst
pals.flavorText: With a heart of ice, this Pal is terrible at expressing its emotions. A solitary individual is pitiable, seen as too clumsy in the eyes of Melpaca.

ability.name: King Of Muscles
ability.description: Can be ridden. While in team, Kingpaca helps carry supplies, increasing the player's max carrying capacity.

pals.name: Daedream
pals.flavorText: It puts those it is interested in to sleep and shows them an endless stream of happy dreams. Those who fall under its spell are never to wake until death takes them.

ability.name: Dream Chaser
ability.description: While in team, appears near the player. Follows up player attacks with magic bullets.

pals.name: Tanzee
pals.flavorText: Long ago, this Pal used long objects like tree branches as weapons. After coming into contact with humans, however, it found something much more effective: guns.

ability.name: Cheery Rifle
ability.description: When activated, Tanzee will mercilessly fire an assault rifle at nearby enemies.

pals.name: Nox
pals.flavorText: If you find Nox hair in your bedding, you should leave it where it lays and leave immediately. Picking it up is a one-way-ticket to a never ending night.

ability.name: Kuudere
ability.description: When fighting together, applies Dark damage to the player's attacks.

pals.name: Flambelle
pals.flavorText: When it starts crying, this Pal produces magma in place of tears. The magma that pours out is absorbed back into its body, causing it to get hotter and hotter. The more it cries, the stronger it becomes.

ability.name: Magma Tears
ability.description: Sometimes produces Flame Organ when assigned to Ranch.

pals.name: Rooby
pals.flavorText: Wild Rooby surprisingly never get sick. Eating one piece of charcoal a day, made by burning a branch, is the secret to its eternal health.

ability.name: Tiny Spark
ability.description: While in team, increases attack power of Fire Pals.

pals.name: Mau
pals.flavorText: Its hard tail does not deteriorate even when cut off. Some believed these severed tails to be good luck, but for the innumerable Mau who were poached as a result, they were anything but.

ability.name: Gold Digger
ability.description: Sometimes digs up Gold Coin when assigned to Ranch.

pals.name: Mau Cryst
pals.flavorText: Its crystalline tail is beautiful, but shatters when this Pal dies. Some believe it is good luck to raise one, so Mau Cryst in captivity are treated with great care.

ability.name: Gold Digger
ability.description: Sometimes digs up Gold Coin when assigned to Ranch.

pals.name: Rushoar
pals.flavorText: Being extremely aggressive Pal, it often picks fights before gauging its opponent's strength. Though small, its powerful charge can even send boulders flying.

ability.name: Hard Head
ability.description: Can be ridden. Increases efficiency of destroying boulders while mounted.

pals.name: Foxparks
pals.flavorText: It is unskilled at controlling fire from the moment it is born and tends to choke on the flames it breathes unintentionally. Foxparks sneezes are one of the leading causes of forest fires.

ability.name: Huggy Fire
ability.description: When activated, equips to the player and transforms into a flamethrower.

pals.name: Killamari
pals.flavorText: It wraps itself around an enemy's head, sucking out their insides. Pal mummies are occasionally found, but these are in fact Killamari victims.

ability.name: Fried Squid
ability.description:
While in team, can be summoned and used instead of a glider.
Can float for long periods of time while gliding.

pals.name: Fuddler
pals.flavorText: Its large claws boast of diamond-like hardness. However, sharpening these claws consumes most of its energy, leading it to sometimes spending entire days doing nothing else.

ability.name: Ore Detector
ability.description: When activated, generates subtle vibrations to detect nearby ore.

pals.name: Eikthyrdeer
pals.flavorText: The one who possesses the most impressive antlers becomes the leader of the herd. If their antlers are broken, they become depressed and leave the herd never to be seen again.

ability.name: Guardian Of The Forest
ability.description:
Can be ridden.
Can perform a double jump while mounted.
Increases efficiency of cutting trees.

pals.name: Eikthyrdeer Terra
pals.flavorText: The individual with the hardest horns becomes the leader. Once the horns are lost, so too is the leadership status. It leaves the herd admist farewell glances and quietly returns to the earth.

ability.name: Guardian Of The Golden Forest
ability.description: Can be ridden. Can perform a double jump while mounted. Increases efficiency of cutting trees.

pals.name: Direhowl
pals.flavorText: Long ago Direhowl would hunt alongside humans but over the years this bond faded.

ability.name: Direhowl Rider
ability.description:
Can be ridden.
Moves slightly faster than most mounts.

pals.name: Caprity
pals.flavorText: The shrub on this pal's back produces berries as long as it is properly fed. It offers these berries to potential mates, and if the flavor is to their liking, romance blossoms.

ability.name: Berry Picker
ability.description: Sometimes drops Red Berries from its back when assigned to Ranch.

pals.name: Swee
pals.flavorText:
Crawling along the ground, it eats microscopic organic matter.
After a while, it discharges any substances that provide no nutrition.
By using it as a mop for cleaning, everyone wins!

ability.name: Fluffy
ability.description: While in team, Sweepa's stats will be increased.

pals.name: Sweepa
pals.flavorText:
While hibernating, a large number of Swee hide within its voluminous body hair.
The most ever recorded is 101.

ability.name: King Of Fluff
ability.description: While fighting together, stats will increase the more Swee are in your team.

pals.name: Hangyu
pals.flavorText:
Its gigantic arms can rip apart even iron.
As a particularly cruel form of execution, serious criminals would be strung up in a public square, and a Hangyu would rip off the skin from their bones.

ability.name: Flying Trapeze
ability.description: While in team, can be summoned and used instead of a glider. Carries the player up high while gliding.

pals.name: Hangyu Cryst
pals.flavorText: Its gigantic arms can tear through blocks of ice. There were times when great sinners were tied in the town square and had their hair torn out by as a brutal form of public humiliation.

ability.name: Winter Trapeze
ability.description: While in team, can be summoned and used instead of a glider. Carries the player up high while gliding.

pals.name: Woolipop
pals.flavorText:
Its entire body is 18,000 times sweeter than sugar.
Carnivorous Pals lured by its scent will find themselves overwhelmed by sweetness and even pass out should they take a bite of this Pal.

ability.name: Candy Pop
ability.description: Sometimes drops Cotton Candy when assigned to ranch.

pals.name: Mozzarina
pals.flavorText: Milk pours from this Pal like water from an open faucet, regardless of its gender. It's truly a mystery of life, although this mystery may be better left unsolved.

ability.name: Milk Maker
ability.description: Sometimes produces Milk when assigned to ranch.

pals.name: Azurobe
pals.flavorText: This Pal's white ribbon turns black if doused with impure water. Given its usefulness in detecting poison, this Pal was once overhunted. This past has left them bitter towards humanity.

ability.name: Waterwing Dance
ability.description: Can be ridden to travel on water. Applies Water damage to the player's attacks while mounted.

pals.name: Sparkit
pals.flavorText: During the dry season, this Pal is always on the verge of blowing a fuse, Sparks can fly with even the slightest provocation even amongst allies.

ability.name: Static Electricity
ability.description: While in team, increases attack power of Electric Pals.

pals.name: Kelpsea
pals.flavorText: Its personality changes depending on the quality of the water it was born into. Kelpsea born into polluted waters are generally ill-tempered and quickly become delinquents.

ability.name: Aqua Spout
ability.description: While in team, increases attack power of Water Pals.

pals.name: Kelpsea Ignis
pals.flavorText: Their personalities change depending on the temperature of the water where they were born. Kelpsea born in warm waters generally have a passionate, motivated personality.

ability.name: Lava Spout
ability.description: While in team, increases attack power of Fire Pals.

pals.name: Ribbuny
pals.flavorText: A Pal who's never without a bright smile. Occasionally, it gets its tentacles tied up in knots by Cattiva's pranks. During those moments, its expression changes into something altogether demonic.

ability.name: Skilled Fingers
ability.description:
While in team, increases attack power of Neutral Pals.
While at base, increases work efficiency if working at Weapon Workbench.

pals.name: Galeclaw
pals.flavorText:
A Pal that can easily take flight even while grasping a human.
 It is, however, prone to letting go when tired, which has led to the sudden demise of more than a few souls.

ability.name: Galeclaw Rider
ability.description: While in team, can be summoned and used instead of a glider. Allows you to fire a gun while gliding with this Pal.

pals.name: Nitewing
pals.flavorText:
It carries newborn Pals to its nest and raises them as a surrogate parent. 
Once the baby Pal has fattened up, it hunts them.

ability.name: Travel Companion
ability.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount.

pals.name: Tombat
pals.flavorText:
Often appears out of the blue to flaunt its prized wings in front of other Pals.
Although it seems to be an intimidation tactic, the Pal seems to derive some kind of pleasure from the display.

ability.name: Ultrasonic Sensor
ability.description: When activated, uses ultrasonic waves to detect the location of nearby Pals.

pals.name: Tocotoco
pals.flavorText: A frightening Pal that produces exploding eggs. It often fires these eggs from its rear end as a weapon, but when spent the Pal itself explodes.

ability.name: Eggbomb Launcher
ability.description: When activated, equips to the player and transforms into an egg launcher.

pals.name: Univolt
pals.flavorText:
It used to be considered an emissary of the Thunder God, and thus was not hunted by people.
However, after witnesses osberved one die from a lightning strike, its reverence faded, and it quite literally fell into the role of a workhorse.

ability.name: Swift Deity
ability.description: Can be ridden. Applies Electric damage to the player's attacks while mounted.

pals.name: Gobfin
pals.flavorText:
Long ago, it was a large and powerful aquatic Pal.
As food became scarce it evolved to live on land.
Since walking requires much energy, it gradually became smaller and is now a small and puny Pal.

ability.name: Angry Shark
ability.description: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with a powerful Aqua Gun. While in team, increases player's attack power.

pals.name: Gobfin Ignis
pals.flavorText: Once upon a time, it was a giant and powerful aquatic Pal. However, with the dwindling availability of food, it ventured onto land. As a consequence of burning many calories to walk, it astonishingly awakened its power to control fire!

ability.name: Angry Shark
ability.description: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with a powerful Spirit Fire. While in team, increases player's attack power.

pals.name: Loupmoon
pals.flavorText: The horns on its head grow under the moonlight. It doesn't hate the sun, but its horns itch when sunlight hits them.

ability.name: Claws Glistening In The Dark
ability.description: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with a powerful Jumping Claw.

pals.name: Cawgnito
pals.flavorText: Long ago it freely soared the skies. After losing a contest with Galeclaw, it abandoned the skies and now lives a quiet nocturnal life.

ability.name: Telepeck
ability.description: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with a powerful Phantom Peck.

pals.name: Arsox
pals.flavorText:
In ancient times, carnivorous Pals pursued them relentlessly.
The Arsox's irrational rage transformed into a raging inferno, which has been passed on to this day.

ability.name: Warm Body
ability.description: Can be ridden. Keeps the rider warm in cold environments.

pals.name: Bristla
pals.flavorText: This prickly Pal's thorns are highly poisonous. It is friendly with Cinnamoth and only smiles when Cinnamoth is drinking its nectar.

ability.name: Princess Gaze
ability.description: While in team, increases attack power of Grass Pals.

pals.name: Cinnamoth
pals.flavorText:
Sniffing its scales produces a feeling of unparalleled euphoria.
There was some effort to further regulate this byproduct, but the Free Pal Alliance have vehemently opposed these measures, putting a stop to them.

ability.name: Mysterious Scales
ability.description: When activated, attacks target enemy with Poison Fog.

pals.name: Elphidran
pals.flavorText: It possesses a demeanor as pure as its appearance suggests. Perhaps because of this, it is sometimes unable to discern good from evil, often allowing wrongdoers to take advantage of it.

ability.name: Amicable Holy Dragon
ability.description:
Can be ridden as a flying mount.
 While fighting together, Dark Pals drop more items when defeated.

pals.name: Elphidran Aqua
pals.flavorText: It possesses a demeanor as pure as its appearance suggests. Perhaps because of this, it harbors no ill will in any of its actions and is indifferent even after killing someone.

ability.name: Amicable Water Dragon
ability.description:
Can be ridden as a flying mount.
While fighting together, Fire Pals drop more items when defeated.

pals.name: Vanwyrm
pals.flavorText:
The melodies of a flute made from the exoskeleton of a Vanwyrm are said to cross the whole mountain ranges.
In ages past, such flutes were used to signal an attack.

ability.name: Aerial Marauder
ability.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Increases damage player deals to enemy weak points while mounted.

pals.name: Vanwyrm Cryst
pals.flavorText: The Melodies of a flute made from the exoskeleton of a Vanwyrm Cryst are said to cross whole mountain ranges. In ages past, such flutes were used to signal victory in a battle.

ability.name: Aerial Marauder
ability.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Increases damage player deals to enemy weak points while mounted.

pals.name: Felbat
pals.flavorText: Attacking from the shadows, this Pal traps its prey within its cloak-like wings. It's probably best not to know what happens within them, or why the inside of its wings are stained red.

ability.name: Life Steal
ability.description: While fighting together, grants the player and Felbat the life steal effect which absorbs some of the received damage and restores HP.

pals.name: Vaelet
pals.flavorText:
The castle was filled with the king's favorite flowers. A great battle ensued, and flames approached the castle. Amidst the chaos, the spirit of a flower appeared.
- From the fairy tale, The King's Flower.

ability.name: Purification Of Gaia
ability.description: While fighting together, Ground Pals drop more items when defeated.

pals.name: Beegarde
pals.flavorText:
A servant that pledges loyalty to Elizabee.
Any that cause harm to the queen are immediately expelled from the hive.
It will gladly give its life to protect its queen.

ability.name: Worker Bee
ability.description:
Sometimes drops Honey when assigned to Ranch.
While in team, Elizabee's stats will be increased.

pals.name: Elizabee
pals.flavorText:
A chosen queen to rule over Beegardes.
There is a never ending stream of servants willing to work themselves to death for the pleasure of serving their queen.

ability.name: Queen Bee Command
ability.description: While fighting together, stats will increase the more Beegarde are in your team.

pals.name: Lovander
pals.flavorText: Seeking a night of love, it is always chasing someone around. At first, it only showed interest in other Pals, but in recent years even humans have become the target of its debauchery.

ability.name: Heart Drain
ability.description: While fighting together, grants the player and Lovander the life steal effect which absorbs some of the received damage and restores HP.

pals.name: Grintale
pals.flavorText:
Grintale's eyes light up the moment anyone enters its territory.
This is no figure of speech-its eyes literally light up.

ability.name: Plump Body
ability.description: Can be ridden. Enhances Neutral attacks while mounted.

pals.name: Leezpunk
pals.flavorText: A Pal that always takes great care to maintain a stylish stance. Always on the hunt for the coolest poses, if given a mirror it will spend all day posing in front of it.

ability.name: Sixth Sense
ability.description: When activated, utilizes its sixth sense to detect nearby dungeons.

pals.name: Leezpunk Ignis
pals.flavorText:
A Pal that has an unusual obsession with their standing posture.
Always in search of the hottest pose, this Pal's owner is constantly presented with fervent stances.

ability.name: Sixth Sense
ability.description: When activated, utilizes its sixth sense to detect nearby dungeons.

pals.name: Gorirat
pals.flavorText: It beats the ground rhythmically to communicate with its comrades. The meaning of each rhythm differs by troop, but the distinction between them is still largely unknown.

ability.name: Full-power Gorilla Mode
ability.description: When activated, unleashes a primal fury that increases Gorirat's attack power.

pals.name: Surfent
pals.flavorText:
Its hydrodynamic form is well suited to life in water.
Poachers often catch them and use them in place of surfboards.

ability.name: Swift Swimmer
ability.description:
Can be ridden to travel on water.
While mounted, prevents stamina depletion while moving over water.

pals.name: Surfent Terra
pals.flavorText: Its aerodynamic form is well suited to life on the sand. Poachers often catch them and use them in place of surfboards

ability.name: Sand Swimmer
ability.description: Can be ridden.

pals.name: Robinquill
pals.flavorText: A pal that is very similar to humans who hunt and live in the forests. It may prove to be a key for understanding what Pals are and how they diverged from humans so long ago.

ability.name: Hawk Eye
ability.description: While fighting together, allows you to deal more damage to weak points.

pals.name: Robinquill Terra
pals.flavorText: A Pal that lives a hunting life in rocky areas and is very close to humans. When bones are found in ruins, there are always human bones found nearby as well.

ability.name: Hawk Eye
ability.description: While fighting together, allows you to deal more damage to weak points.

pals.name: Flopie
pals.flavorText: It prefers places that have an abundance of vegetation, but hay fever has apparently become a problem for Flopie as of late.

ability.name: Helper Bunny
ability.description: While in team, appears nearby the player. Automatically picks up nearby items.

pals.name: Wixen
pals.flavorText: With the power of light, it produces arcane phenomena. It prefers to eat food well-done and is particularly hostile towards Katress.

ability.name: Lord Fox
ability.description: When fighting together, applies Fire damage to the player's attacks.

pals.name: Katress
pals.flavorText: With the power of shadows it produces arcane phenomena. It prefers to eat food raw and is particularly hostile towards Wixen

ability.name: Grimoire Collector
ability.description: While fighting together, Neutral Pals drop more items when defeated.

pals.name: Helzephyr
pals.flavorText: It calls forth lightning from the depths of hell. One who dies from Helzephyr's inferno is sure to be sent to the underworld.

ability.name: Wings Of Death
ability.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Applies Dark damage to the player's attacks while mounted.

pals.name: Lunaris
pals.flavorText: It can control those who carelessly stare into its eyes. Those seen with a Lunaris are in its mind, simply under its control.

ability.name: Antigravity
ability.description: While in team, Lunaris manipulates gravity, increasing the player's max carrying capacity.

pals.name: Fenglope
pals.flavorText: In ancient times, it was a familiar subject for painting because of its beautiful and majestic appearance. Fenglope is an endangered species, the Fenglope whose beautiful fur and horns are much sought after by poachers!

ability.name: Wind And Clouds
ability.description: Can be ridden. Can double jump while mounted.

pals.name: Dinossom
pals.flavorText: A Pal who once angered cannot be pacified. It rages on and on like an inferno. The prahse "step on a Dinossom's tail" has come to mean enraging someone.

ability.name: Fragrant Dragon
ability.description:
Can be ridden.
Enchances Grass attacks while mounted.

pals.name: Dinossom Lux
pals.flavorText: Though struck by lightning, it lives on. The phrase "struck by a Dinossom Lux's bolt" has come to mean narrowly escaping death.

ability.name: Thunder Dragon
ability.description: Can be ridden. Enhances Electric attacks while mounted.

pals.name: Bushi
pals.flavorText: Its body becomes a blade upon death, to be taken up by the next generation. If someone other than a Bushi wields this blade, the soul within torments them until they are driven mad.

ability.name: Brandish Blade
ability.description: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with a powerful Iaigiri.

pals.name: Mammorest
pals.flavorText: The vegetation on its back varies between individuals. There is a long history of appreciating this veritable garden of a Pal, and there are even Mammorest pruning specialists.

ability.name: Gaia Crusher
ability.description: Can be ridden. Improves efficiency of cutting trees and mining ores while mounted.

pals.name: Mammorest Cryst
pals.flavorText: The vegetation on its back varies from individual to individual. There was a time when seeds of presumed extinct plants were found still frozen on the back of a Mammorest Cryst.

ability.name: Ice Crusher
ability.description: Can be ridden. Improves efficiency of cutting trees and mining ores while mounted.

pals.name: Petallia
pals.flavorText: A pal that transforms into a massive plant when at the end of its life. Once every ten years, a beautiful flower blooms and a new Petallia is born.

ability.name: Blessing Of The Flower Spirit
ability.description: When activated, uses medicinal flowers to restore the player's HP.

pals.name: Incineram
pals.flavorText:
In the dark of night, this Pal snatches prey to bring back ot its territory.
What happens to those poor souls afterwards isn't too hard to imagine.

ability.name: Flameclaw Hunter
ability.description: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with a powerful Hellfire Claw.

pals.name: Incineram Noct
pals.flavorText: It specifically targets baby pals, taking them back to its territory. One can only imagine the profound despair of the parent Pal, whose child has been taken away.

ability.name: Darkclaw Hunter
ability.description: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with a powerful Hellfire Claw.

pals.name: Dazzi
pals.flavorText:
Often kind to lonely pals.
However, the moment a Pal mistakes this for actual companionship, it seizes the opportunity to blast them with a thunderbolt.

ability.name: Lady Of Lightning
ability.description: While in team, appears near the player. Follows up player attacks with lightning bolts.

pals.name: Pyrin
pals.flavorText:
It's entire body has evolved into a highly efficient radiator, gifting it with astounding stamina.
When someone has mounted it, this Pal takes caution not to burn them.

ability.name: Red Hare
ability.description: Can be ridden. Applies Fire damage to the player's attacks while mounted.

pals.name: Pyrin Noct
pals.flavorText:
It burns mysterious dark matter as energy and expels the remaining particles from its body.
If someone rides it, they should take care so as not to gallop down the path of darkness.

ability.name: Black Hare
ability.description: Can be ridden. Applies Dark damage to the player's attacks while mounted.

pals.name: Relaxaurus
pals.flavorText:
Contrary to its blasÃ© appearance, it's quite ferocious.
It perceives everything in its sight as prey and will stop at nothing to devour it.

ability.name: Hungry Missile
ability.description: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a missile launcher while mounted.

pals.name: Relaxaurus Lux
pals.flavorText: One day, Relaxaurus had an idea. Maybe it was about time for a change. Just then, an electric shock raced through its body!

ability.name: Missile Party
ability.description: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a missile launcher while mounted.

pals.name: Foxcicle
pals.flavorText: On nights when the aurora is visible, it looks up towards the sky and begins to howl a beautiful song. This does, however, leave it vulnerable to attacks from enemies.

ability.name: Aurora Guide
ability.description: While in a team, increases attack power of Ice pals.

pals.name: Beakon
pals.flavorText: Some think it is a related species to Ragnahawk, but there is in fact no connection. Using its sharp beak, it descends on its prey in a quick motion that resembles a bolt of lightning.

ability.name: Thunderous
ability.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Applies Electric damage to the player's attacks while mounted.

pals.name: Rayhound
pals.flavorText: At full speed, it could be mistaken for a bolt of lightning. If two Rayhounds collide, the sound is like that of a powerful thunderclap.

ability.name: Jumping Force
ability.description: Can be ridden. Can double jump while mounted.

pals.name: Menasting
pals.flavorText: Being made of pure energy, its insides are completely hollow. This Pal crams still-living prey into its hollow body, where it absorbs them. Hellish screams of pain can often be heard coming from inside this Pal.

ability.name: Steel Scorpion
ability.description: When fighting together, increases the player's defense and Electric Pals drop more items when defeated.

pals.name: Reindrix
pals.flavorText: Its transparent cerulean antlers glow with the cold of absolute zero. Any who touch them with their bare hands are instantly frozen over and smashed into pieces.

ability.name: Cool Body
ability.description:
Can be ridden.
Keeps the rider cool in hot environments.

pals.name: Mossanda
pals.flavorText: A Pal so powerful it's hard to believe. In one experiment, this Pal tore through 3,000 sheets of paper at once! It's only by some miracle that this Pal isn't a meat-eater.

ability.name: Grenadier Panda
ability.description: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a grenade launcher while mounted.

pals.name: Mossanda Lux
pals.flavorText: A Pal whose power is truly shocking. By altering the electrical currents in its body, this Pal's been able to overload its own strength. When it comes to sheer power, this Pal may be top of the list.

ability.name: Plane Partner
ability.description: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a grenade launcher while mounted.

pals.name: Chillet
pals.flavorText:
It can curl up its body and roll around at extremely high speeds.
Long ago, people would tie bags of milk to domesticated Chillet as they grazed to produce butter using this spinning force.

ability.name: Wriggling Weasel
ability.description:
Can be ridden.
Applies Dragon Dragon damage to the player's attacks while mounted.

pals.name: Ragnahawk
pals.flavorText: Some think it is a related species to Beakon, but there is in fact no connection. It mainly eats rocks, and after many long years its beak and head have hardened to accommodate this diet.

ability.name: Flame Wing
ability.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Applies Fire damage to the player's attacks while mounted.

pals.name: Digtoise
pals.flavorText: A walking contradiction, possessing the strongest shell and the only drill capable of piercing it. "Digtoise's Fable" is a popular children's tale.

ability.name: Drill Crusher
ability.description: When activated, performs Shell Spin, follows the player while spinning, and mines ores efficiently.

pals.name: Broncherry
pals.flavorText:
Its scent drastically changes before and after pairing.
It exudes a pleasing aroma after finding a partner, which is called the "fragrance of first love."

ability.name: Overaffectionate
ability.description: Can be ridden. While in team, Broncherry helps carry supplies, increasing the player's max carrying capacity.

pals.name: Broncherry Aqua
pals.flavorText: Its scent drastically changes before and after pairing. It exudes a pleasing aroma before finding a partner, which is called the "perfume of purity."

ability.name: Overaffectionate
ability.description: Can be ridden. While in team, Broncherry helps carry supplies, increasing the player's max carrying capacity.

pals.name: Dumud
pals.flavorText:
When too relaxed, its reaction time drastically declines.
Even if it were sliced from head to tail, it probably wouldn't even realize that it should be dead until the next morning.

ability.name: Soil Improver
ability.description: While in team, increases attack power of Ground Pals.

pals.name: Kitsun
pals.flavorText: Despite its appearance, Kitsun is extremely sensitive and will flee into a cave when spooked. Long ago, it was considered and ill omen if one were found nearby.

ability.name: Clear Mind
ability.description: Can be ridden. Unaffected by the cold or heat while riding this Pal.

pals.name: Blazehowl
pals.flavorText: While it prefers raw meat, it always ends up eating well-done meat. This is due to its blistering claws, which it uses as its weaponâ€”it simply doesn't realize its prey gets burned to a crisp.

ability.name: Hellflame Lion
ability.description: Can be ridden. While fighting together, Grass Pals drop more items when defeated.

pals.name: Blazehowl Noct
pals.flavorText: While it prefers raw meat, it always ends up eating tainted meat. This is due to its dark claws, which it uses as its weaponâ€”it simply doesn't realize its prey got cursed.

ability.name: Darkflame Lion
ability.description: Can be ridden. While fighting together, Neutral Pals drop more items when defeated.

pals.name: Warsect
pals.flavorText:
The ultra-hard armor surrounding its body is extremely strong and heat resistant.
Even a napalm blast would hardly leave a scratch.

ability.name: Hard Armor
ability.description: When fighting together, increases player's defense and applies Fire damage to the player's attacks.

pals.name: Sibelyx
pals.flavorText: A Pal that likes the rain,and will often bask in rain showers until the weather clears up. On rainy days, Foxparks can often be found taking shelter beneath it.

ability.name: Silk Maker
ability.description: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with a powerful Blizzard Spike. Sometimes produces High Quality Cloth when assigned to Ranch.

pals.name: Maraith
pals.flavorText: It relishes the peculiar scent living things give off when they are near death. If a Mariath has taken a liking to you. It is safe to assume that is why.

ability.name: Messenger Of Death
ability.description:
Can be ridden.
Applies Dark damage to the player's attacks while mounted.

pals.name: Jormuntide
pals.flavorText: Legends says the Jormuntide was once a wise man, who after being wrongly convicted and cast into a whirlpool, returned as this Pal to destroy those who wronged him.

ability.name: Stormbringer Sea Dragon
ability.description: Can be ridden to travel on water. While mounted, prevents stamina depletion while moving over water.

pals.name: Jormuntide Ignis
pals.flavorText: Legend says the Jormuntide Ignis was once a warrior who, after being wrongly convicted and cast into a volcano, returned as this Pal to destroy those who wronged him.

ability.name: Stormbringer Lava Dragon
ability.description: Can be ridden. Enhances Fire attacks while mounted.

pals.name: Suzaku
pals.flavorText: It was once believed to usher in the dry season. Whenever there was a drought in the previous year, people would relentlessly seek to cull it's numbers, hoping to bring a plentiful harvest in the next year.

ability.name: Wings Of Flame
ability.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Enhances Fire attacks while mounted.

pals.name: Suzaku Aqua
pals.flavorText: It was once believed to usher in the rainy season. If there was a flood the previous year, people would relentlessly seek to cull its numbers, hoping to avert disaster in the coming year.

ability.name: Wings Of Water
ability.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Enhances Water attacks while mounted.

pals.name: Quivern
pals.flavorText: Sleeping while cuddling a Quivern is said to be a heavenly experience, but there are some who have been crushed and sent to heaven by ones that toss and turn in their sleep.

ability.name: Sky Dragon's Affection
ability.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Enhances Dragon attacks while mounted.

pals.name: Reptyro
pals.flavorText: Magma-like blood runs throughout its body. If a large amount of water is thrown on it, this water rapidly heats, causing an immense vapor explosion.

ability.name: Ore-loving Beast
ability.description: Can be ridden. Improves efficiency of mining ores while mounted.

pals.name: Reptyro Cryst
pals.flavorText: Ice cold blood runs throughout its body. If heated rapidly, its blood evaporates, causing an immense vapor explosion.

ability.name: Ice-loving Beast
ability.description: Can be ridden. Improves efficiency of mining ores while mounted.

pals.name: Cryolinx
pals.flavorText: It can easily climb steep mountains with its hard claws. However, its short legs make it difficult to descend, often leaving it stranded in high places.

ability.name: Dragon Hunter
ability.description: While fighting together, Dragon Pals drop more items when defeated.

pals.name: Wumpo
pals.flavorText: Researchers once tried to shave off its hair to reveal its true form. In the end, only hair was left, as if that was all there was to begin with.

ability.name: Guardian Of The Snowy Mountain
ability.description: Can be ridden. While in team, Wumpo helps carry supplies, increasing the player's max carrying capacity.

pals.name: Wumpo Botan
pals.flavorText: researchers once tried to cut the grass off its body to reveal its true form. In the end, only grass was left, as if that was all there was to begin with.

ability.name: Guardian Of The Grassy Fields
ability.description: Can be ridden. While in team, Wumpo Botan helps carry supplies, increasing the player's max carrying capacity.

pals.name: Blazamut
pals.flavorText: Legends say it was born during a volcanic eruption. A strange group even claims that this continent is laid upon the back of a giant Blazamut.

ability.name: Magma Kaiser
ability.description: Can be ridden. Enchances Fire attacks while mounted.

pals.name: Anubis
pals.flavorText: Once seen as a symbol of nobility, and an idol for those who shunned wealth and power. Yet over time, this Pal became a token of death.

ability.name: Guardian Of The Desert
ability.description: When fighting together, applies Ground damage to the player's attacks. Sometimes dodges attacks with a high speed sidestep while in a battle.

pals.name: Verdash
pals.flavorText: Land that Verdash has run across becomes extremely fertile, with thick vegetation growing there soon after. It will not run anywhere that herbicide has been used.

ability.name: Grassland Speedster
ability.description: When fighting together, increases player's movement speed and applies Grass damage to the player's attacks.

pals.name: Astegon
pals.flavorText: A savage beast born of the abyss. Thou shall not stand before the beast. Thou shall not heed the beast.

ability.name: Black Anklyosaur
ability.description: Can be ridden a flying mount. Increases damage dealt to ore while mounted.

pals.name: Grizzbolt
pals.flavorText: With a friendly smile and a hardy physique, it is docile towards one it recognizes as a partner. For reasons unexplained, its personality undergoes a drastic change when wielding a minigun.

ability.name: Yellow Tank
ability.description: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a minigun while mounted.

pals.name: Lyleen
pals.flavorText:
A docile Pal full of love.
It watches over small Pals who have lost their parents. It uses a full-power Solar Blast to discipline naughty Pals.

ability.name: Harvest Goddess
ability.description: When activated, the queen's soothing graces greatly restore the player's HP.

pals.name: Lyleen Noct
pals.flavorText: An elegant Pal full of grace. It admonishes any who are disrespectful with a painful slap. Some Pals actively seek out this punishment.

ability.name: Goddess Of The Tranquil Light
ability.description: When activated, the queen's soothing graces greatly restore the player's HP.

pals.name: Orserk
pals.flavorText: It sends electricity into its foes' wounds, roasting them from the inside out. Fights between Orserk end in the blink of an eye.

ability.name: Ferocious Thunder Dragon
ability.description: While fighting together, Water Pals drop more items when defeated.

pals.name: Faleris
pals.flavorText: When it finds its prey it unleashes a whirlwind of flames, burning the entire area to ash. Faleris breath is known for its pleasing scent.

ability.name: Scorching Predator
ability.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While fighting together, Ice Pals drop more items when defeated.

pals.name: Shadowbeak
pals.flavorText:
Forbidden existence born of madness.
As he lost his genetic relationship with the other Pals, he may no longer be considered one of them.

ability.name: Modified Dna
ability.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Enhances Dark attacks while mounted.

pals.name: Paladius
pals.flavorText:
In the past, he and Necromus were a single species.
They say that they are an existence that has freed themselves from all negative feelings, but the depths of their eyes harbor traces of resentment.

ability.name: Holy Knight Of The Firmament
ability.description: Can be ridden. Can triple jump while mounted.

pals.name: Necromus
pals.flavorText:
Once he and Paladius were a single species.
They say it is the manifestation of negative feelings, but the depths of their eyes contain traces of compassion.

ability.name: Dark Knight Of The Abyss
ability.description: Can be ridden. Can double jump while mounted.

pals.name: Frostallion
pals.flavorText: Guardian deity of Palpagos Island, known as the Winter Caller. In the past, when a calamity struck the land, it soared into the sky and sealed away the threat by casting the island into an eternal winter.

ability.name: Ice Steed
ability.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Changes the player's attack type to Ice and enhances Ice attacks while mounted.

pals.name: Frostallion Noct
pals.flavorText: Guardian deity of Palpagos Island known as the Night Caller. In the past, when a calamity struck the land, it soared into the sky and sealed away the threat by casting the island into eternal darkness.

ability.name: Black Steed
ability.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Changes the player's attack type to Dark and enhances Dark attacks while mounted.

pals.name: Jetragon
pals.flavorText:
Looks over the island of Palpagos from the ends of the sky.
When the calamity awakens again, splitting the earth and setting the heavens on fire, he will destroy it with a glare of complete obliteration.

ability.name: Aerial Missile
ability.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Can rapidly fire a missile launcher while mounted.

Absorbs a portion of the damage dealt to restore Health. 
Does not sleep at night and continues to work.

Pacifist.

passives.description: Tends to nap through the day, due to being nocturnal.
